owner_decision: owner 2026-11-15 "yes" (relayed by the coordinator): research whether the CLEAN model beats the OPEN (T-48h) price where it does not beat later prices, per league x market x side; development rows before 2026-09-01 only; any signal becomes a pre-registered forward paper protocol from 2026-11-21; nothing in production changes.
registered_before_run: this file's sha256 (LF line ends) is written to config/opening_price_edge_protocol_ledger.json and committed BEFORE `scripts/opening_price_edge.py run` computes any ROI, CLV or p-value; `run` refuses any other hash. `prepare` (prices and coverage counts only, no outcome read) may run before registration.

data.rows: stage walk_forward AND the Phase-2 model holdout stage (2026-04-01..), markets over15 / over25 / over35 / btts, dated before dev_end_exclusive. Both stages are out-of-sample for the model. No row is filled or dropped for any other reason; a row without a price pair for a role is simply not priced for that role.
data.spent_windows_labelled: rows inside the bars fresh-holdout windows of TP-FH-2026-11-15-132a4795 (Standard over15_over 2025-03-01..2026-08-03, over35_over 2025-03-01..2026-05-09; New-Format over25 2024-09-01..2025-06-22, over15_over ..2025-06-27, over35_over ..2025-06-22) had their outcomes seen at BT / football-data prices; they stay in (this is development, no historical holdout is claimed) and every verdict is DEVELOPMENT evidence only.

oddsapi_store.note: tier C1 is still being collected at this commit (no C1 for Sweden Allsvenskan, Turkish Super Lig, USA MLS, Portuguese Primeira Liga; Serie B partial): those cells have fewer or no OPEN rows and stay in the Holm family.

adapter.rule: prices ONLY through attach / prices_for / attach_to_universe with an explicit purpose; the adapter drops every post-kickoff quote, every quote without a snapshot time and every price <= 1.01; fixtures joined by the adapter's own proven mapping (match_universe: one league, match day +-1 with both clubs proven, one-to-one) using the store's ledger aliases (load_context).

fd_prematch.rule: Standard O/U 2.5 only: the certified one-to-one join (certified_ou25); bet price = the PRE-MATCH same-book pair (Bet365, else Pinnacle); its CLOSING pair (B365C, else PC) is read for CLV only.

roles.OPEN: tier C1, snapshot 'T-48h' (event odds, btts + alternate_totals), adapter purpose 'open'. A BET-ABLE early price.
roles.BET: tier BT, snapshot 'bet' (T-125h Standard / T-153h New-Format; event odds, btts + alternate_totals), adapter purpose 'bet'. NOTE: in time BT is EARLIER than OPEN.
roles.FD_PRE: football-data pre-match O/U 2.5 pair (Standard only; the provider captures it roughly 1-3 days before kickoff).
roles.CLOSE: tier B1, snapshot 'close' (~9 minutes before kickoff), adapter purpose 'close'. CLV ONLY - never a bet price, never an ROI.
roles.MOVEMENT: tier B4, featured 'totals' (main line, h2h ignored), labels timed off the DAY's first kickoff; each snapshot is placed by its median hours before the fixture's OWN actual kickoff. Edge-decay description only (Q3) - never a bet price, never an ROI, never a test.

prices.bet_price: per side the MEDIAN across books of the role's snapshot (adapter summary 'median'; one quote per book). FD_PRE: the single-book pair.
prices.fair: power de-vig (src.market_edge.power_devig) of the role's two-sided (median yes, median no) pair; a row needs both sides, else it is not priced for that role.
prices.best_price: per side the best book price: reported as ROI context only, no CI, no test, no verdict.

model_probability.p_side: the champion_recipe p for the yes side (over / btts yes), 1 - p for the no side.
model_probability.calibrated: R2 calibration of research/top3-ranking: p_cal = fair + lam * (p_side - fair), lam from top3_ranking._lams (least squares of (won - fair) on (p_side - fair) over the cell's own prior priced rows, shrunk toward the same league's other market-sides by DerSimonian-Laird, clipped to [0, 1]; a market-side needs MIN_OWN_BETS = 40 own rows). Fitted WALK-FORWARD per (track, role): for every calendar month M, on that role's priced rows (that role's own fair) dated before the first day of M; the cell key is (track, league, market-side).
model_probability.raw_flag: a bet whose cell has no lam yet (fewer than 40 prior priced rows of that market-side, or no spread) uses p_cal = p_side and is flagged RAW; each cell reports its RAW share.

bet_rule.one_configuration: bet side s of a priced row in role r when p_cal(s, r) * odds(s, r) - 1 > 0; flat 1 unit; pnl = odds - 1 if the side won else -1. No odds range, no edge bar, no other configuration is searched.
bet_rule.two_sides: both sides of one market cannot both clear the rule (p_cal_yes + p_cal_no = 1 < the booked sum).

statistics.roi: mean pnl of the cell's bets.
statistics.clv: per bet odds_bet * fair_close - 1, fair_close = power de-vig of the CLOSE (B1) median pair; FD_PRE uses the football-data closing pair. Bets without a closing pair have no CLV (counted).
statistics.se: src.bars_opt.study.max_se: the LARGEST of the iid, match-day-block and ISO-week-block standard errors of the mean.
statistics.p: one-sided p = 1 - Phi(mean / se) for H1 mean > 0; a cell with fewer than 2 bets or se 0 / NaN gets p = 1.

holm_family.members: every (track, league, market, side, role) with role in {OPEN, BET} for every universe league that has an OddsAPI sport key, plus role FD_PRE for (Standard, league, over25, yes/no) for every Standard league with fd_raw files - each tested on TWO statistics (ROI and CLV). The family is enumerated from the universe BEFORE any effect is computed; a member with no bet or no p-value still counts (p = 1).
holm_family.method: Holm step-down over the whole family (ROI and CLV tests together).

verdicts.PROVEN: ROI statistic: n >= 150 bets AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.025 AND 95% CI lower bound > 0.
verdicts.PROMISING: not PROVEN, n >= 150, ROI > 0, and (the unadjusted 95% ROI lower bound > 0 OR the unadjusted 95% CLV lower bound > 0). Forward-paper candidate only; never a bet.
verdicts.UNPROVEN: n >= 150 and neither of the above.
verdicts.EARLY_ONLY: OPEN verdict in {PROVEN, PROMISING} while the same league x market x side at BET is not (answers 'beats OPEN where it does not beat BT').
verdicts.label: every verdict is DEVELOPMENT evidence on rows before 2026-09-01 (some outcomes already seen in earlier studies); it becomes actionable only through the forward paper protocol.

descriptive_only.pooled: per track x market x side pooled over leagues (context, no verdict, not in the family).
descriptive_only.movement_q3: for the OPEN-selected and the BET-selected bets of each cell: mean (odds_selected * fair_t - 1) for t in BET, OPEN, MOVEMENT buckets by hours before the own kickoff [>36h, 18-36h, 8-18h, 3-8h, 0.5-3h] and CLOSE, beside the mean calibrated EV at selection; MOVEMENT for over25 only (featured main line) and before 2026-06-14.
descriptive_only.clv_drift: per cell: mean (fair_close - fair_role) of the selected side for selected vs not-selected rows (does the price move toward the model's side when it likes it?).

q4_timing.ledgers: origin/main output/bets_ledger.csv (O/U 2.5) and output/side_bets_ledger.csv (over15 / over35 / btts ...), source 'live'; one row per first sight (the ledger deduplicates and the first logged row stands).
q4_timing.kickoff: the fixture's actual kickoff from the OddsAPI store listings through the adapter's match_universe + actual_kickoffs (UTC); generated_at is UTC (src/ledger.py utcnow).
q4_timing.measure: hours = kickoff - generated_at; shares >= 48h (an OPEN price could be taken), >= 125h / >= 153h (a BT-time price), per track and market; unmatched fixtures counted, never guessed.

public_outputs: output/research/opening_price_edge/{coverage,results,timing}.json and reports/OPENING_PRICE_EDGE.md: counts, ROI, CLV, CI, p-values only. No OddsAPI price, no priced row, no per-fixture line ever enters the repo or a log; priced intermediates stay in --local outside the repo.
forward: cells with an OPEN verdict PROVEN or PROMISING go into a separate forward paper protocol (config/opening_price_edge_forward_protocol.json, hash-registered) starting 2026-11-21; the owner decides.
